A_{II}=\left(\frac s2\right)^2=\frac{s^2}{4}.

\frac12\left(\frac s2\right)^2=\frac{s^2}{8}.

\[
A_{III}=4\left(\frac{s^2}{16}\right)=\frac{s^2}{4}.
\]
